item.name: Get Two credit summary

request.name: Get Two credit summary

description.content: Returns the buyer's Two credit summary. The `status` field signals which of four conditions applies: `available` (totals populated), `not_configured` (buyer has no Two integration), `revoked` (Two denied credit and recourse cannot compensate), or `api_error` (transient upstream failure — retry may succeed). When status is not `available`, all credit figures are null. `total_credit` / `available_for_new_orders` are the legacy additive model (Two organic + recourse) the frontend shows by default. `max_total_credit` is the shared-envelope limit — the LARGER of the Two organic or Allianz limit (not their sum). `max_available_for_new_orders` is that limit minus all allocated orders (Two organic drawn first), UNCLAMPED — negative when the buyer is over their limit, so the finance card can show the over-by amount. The frontend switches to the `max_*` fields behind the credit-limit feature flag. Monetary values are in cents.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.

description.content:
ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.

description.content:
ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.

description.content:
ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.

description.content:
ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

description.content:
ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

description.content:
ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.

ViewSet for managing app orders from the merchant of record perspective.

This ViewSet provides endpoints for merchant of record companies to:
- List and retrieve their app orders
- Manage order lifecycle (approve, reject, mark as paid, etc.)
- Upload and manage order documents
- Create order events and comments
- Generate purchase order PDFs
- Handle invoice URLs
- Duplicate orders
- Create new orders

All operations are restricted to orders where the current user's company
is the merchant of record.
